subject: complete in-process Auth Service authorization evaluation epoch

seams.neutral_check: Every declared candidate path hashes to its frozen digest.
seams.mutation: Replace one digest with a stale predecessor.

seams.neutral_check: Every tested obligation derives from a named definition, contract, ontology invariant, or product outcome.
Definition to capability to ontology/contracts to DomainSpec scaffold to implementation lineage is complete and ordered.
seams.mutation: Substitute the older two-connection service binding.

seams.neutral_check: Every case produces exactly one tool-owned observation bound to its case and candidate digests.
seams.mutation: Supply zero observations, duplicate observations, or a caller-authored PASS.

seams.neutral_check: One database identity, connection, captured decision time, and read transaction cover all provider reads and evaluation.
seams.mutation: Open a second connection, recapture time, or end the transaction before kernel evaluation.

seams.neutral_check: The service accepts only evidence and route references and returns only ALLOW or DENY; excluded credentials, tokens, HTTP, administration, and deployment remain absent.
seams.mutation: Permit caller-supplied permission, scope, role, revision, or decision data.

seams.neutral_check: ALLOW requires exact cardinality, current evidence, subject/session equality, complete current revision joins, exact permission, and trusted scope; every uncertainty denies.
seams.mutation: Allow one mismatch, stale revision, incomplete relation, or provider uncertainty to reach ALLOW.

adjudication.pass: All seven neutral cases pass, all seven mutations are detected exactly once, every case has exactly one tool-owned observation, the denominator is non-empty and unchanged, no mutation survives, and both complete runs are byte-identical.
adjudication.fail: Any evaluated neutral case fails or any mutation survives.
adjudication.not_evaluable: Any bound digest changes; any case or seam is missing; observations are zero, duplicate, caller-supplied, stale, malformed, or incomplete; or the two-run replay is unavailable.

claim_limit: Prepared EVF campaign only; no observation, test PASS, EVF conformance, product approval, publication, release, deployment, or external authority.
